garnet_char.art_note: Descent • Garnet Spring trout: Chalk-white cave life and growing garnet crystals.

vaultjaw_wyrm.art_note: A long garnet-veined cave wyrm with a mineral jaw and eyeless stone brow.

bastion_barbel.art_note: A rampart-backed barbel whose stone plates form a small aquatic bastion.

masque_bream.art_note: A broad ballroom fish wearing a two-tone masquerade mask.

ribbon_sailfin.art_note: A fish formed from several sweeping satin ribbons and a high folded sail.

v22_birchbank_crayfish.name: Birchbank Crayfish
v22_birchbank_crayfish.habitat: Upstream lake • island narrows and deep basin
v22_birchbank_crayfish.note: Olive lake crayfish with copper claw tips, a curled fan tail and pale birch-like bands. Found only around the lake islands and basin; use a net or baited cage. Bring it home alive to record it.

v23_atlas_leviathan.name: Atlas Leviathan
v23_atlas_leviathan.note: A living folded sea chart with inked contour lines and a compass eye. Found only in Folded Coast.

v23_oldwater_crownback.name: Oldwater Crownback
v23_oldwater_crownback.note: An ancient lake fish with a crown of reed-shaped dorsal fins and bronze-ringed scales. Requires Scented Worms AND Rain; bring your catch home alive.

v23_pelagic_monarch.name: Pelagic Monarch
v23_pelagic_monarch.note: A deep-water ribbon sovereign with silver constellation markings and a sweeping crescent tail. Return alive to record it.

v23_midnight_glassfin.name: Midnight Glassfin
v23_midnight_glassfin.habitat: Oldwater Lake • Island Narrows and Deep Lake Basin
v23_midnight_glassfin.note: A translucent lake fish with a dark spine and luminous blue fin edges. Night only, 20:00–06:00. Return alive to record it.

v23_squallfin_marlin.name: Squallfin Marlin
v23_squallfin_marlin.habitat: Ocean • Sunlit Shoals and Broken Crown Reef
v23_squallfin_marlin.note: A streamlined marlin with a tall storm-striped sail. Feeds only in Rain. Return alive to record it.

v23_duskveil_manta.name: Duskveil Manta
v23_duskveil_manta.habitat: Ocean • Swaying Kelp Forest and Outer Deep Channel
v23_duskveil_manta.note: A broad manta with pale speckled shoulders and a curling whip tail. Night only, 20:00–06:00. Return alive to record it.

v25_copper_reef_lobster.name: Copper Reef Lobster
v25_copper_reef_lobster.habitat: Ocean • Broken Crown Reef / Kelp Forest
v25_copper_reef_lobster.note: Heavy copper claws, a curled striped tail and pale reef freckles. Cage catch; favours Kelp Crumble or Fish Roe.

v25_pearl_spiny_lobster.name: Pearl Spiny Lobster
v25_pearl_spiny_lobster.note: Long branching antennae, pearl-white spines and a midnight-blue segmented tail. A rare cage catch; favours Fish Roe.

v25_mossback_crab.name: Mossback Crab
v25_mossback_crab.note: A low, broad green crab with algae-like mottling and one oversized claw. Cage catch; favours Fish Roe.

v25_crown_reef_crab.name: Crown Reef Crab
v25_crown_reef_crab.habitat: Ocean • Broken Crown Reef / Outer Deep Channel
v25_crown_reef_crab.note: A spiked golden carapace and dark paddle-shaped legs distinguish this large reef crab. Cage catch; favours Kelp Crumble or Fish Roe.

siltglass_perch.name: Siltglass Perch
siltglass_perch.note: Found only in this sealed Descent spring. A translucent flank reveals a pale mineral spine.

amberbarbel.name: Amberbarbel
amberbarbel.note: Found only in this sealed Descent spring. Long amber whiskers feel for cracks in the silt.

faultline_ray.name: Faultline Ray
faultline_ray.note: Found only in this sealed Descent spring. Its broad folded fins slip between narrow fault seams.

pressurefin_gar.name: Pressurefin Gar
pressurefin_gar.note: Found only in this sealed Descent spring. A long armored jaw and pressure-hardened scales.

midnight_crown_eel.name: Midnight Crown Eel
midnight_crown_eel.note: Found only in this sealed Descent spring. A crown of pale sensory pores follows the darkness.

dockstripe_perch.name: Dockstripe Perch
dockstripe_perch.note: Bold charcoal bands disappear into the shadows of the wooden pilings. Only found at the marina.

lanternwake_burbot.name: Lanternwake Burbot
lanternwake_burbot.note: A mottled freshwater hunter with a long chin barbel, emerging after the lamps are lit. Only found at the marina.

marina_mussel.name: Marina Mussel
marina_mussel.note: A freshwater mussel with a dark violet shell and pale growth rings. Collected only in a baited basket at the marina.
